finalText:
**Fixed.** Pages are 1-indexed, but `paginate` was multiplying by the page number as if page 1 were page 0. So page 1 handed back the second batch. Now it starts at `(page - 1) * perPage`.

All 5 tests pass in 70ms.

One aside: run them as `node --test tests/paginate.test.js`. On this Node, `node --test tests` tries to load the folder as a file and blows up.
